description: Reviewed corrections of html5lib tree-construction corpus expectations that contradict the pinned W3C HTML5 REC 2014-10-28 or record post-target behavior. A case counts as decided when the engine output equals correctedDocument for a reviewed entry; reviewed entries are never overwritten by regeneration.

cases.reason: in a fragment whose context is a foreign element the stack holds only the synthetic html root, so the any-other-end-tag walk aborts at the topmost element ("fragment case") and the end token is dropped; the corpus inserts the element the end tag names
